text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I was able to debut safely. But... I made 
my mom, dad, and even Trainer-san worry, 
after they went through the trouble of 
coming to see me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
My body was just too young, and it seems I 
couldn't endure the strain of the race. At 
this rate, I won't be able to help Trainer 
at all...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
The Hanshin JF... If I do my best in a big 
GⅠ race, people will say I'm amazing 
instead of worrying about me, right?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky-san is cheering for me too. I 
hope I can run in lots of races from now 
on and make plenty of flowers bloom.
